sources.title: Brest-Litovsk treaty map annex preserved by the Political Archive of the German Federal Foreign Office
sources.coverage: Map annex to the German original of the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, March 1918, showing the treaty demarcation line
sources.notes: The digitized reproduction identifies the Political Archive of the German Federal Foreign Office as the holding archive and the image as an excerpt of Annex 1 to the German treaty copy, with the demarcation line marked in blue. Wikimedia Commons marks the official-work image public domain under German law. Production geometry still requires reproducible acquisition of the full relevant map extent, controlled georeferencing and spatial validation.

sources.title: UN Treaty Series records for the 1945 Czechoslovakia-USSR Trans-Carpathian Ukraine settlement and later frontier demarcation instruments
sources.coverage: Treaty of 29 June 1945, its attached-map boundary rule, and the later official record identifying the 1945-1946 demarcation package
sources.notes: UNTS volume 504 publishes the 1945 treaty; Article 1 makes the former Slovakia/Trans-Carpathian Ukraine frontier, with stated changes, the Czechoslovak-USSR frontier according to an attached map. UNTS volume 971 later identifies the authoritative descriptive protocol, map album, cartographic materials and geodetic studies from the November 1945-April 1946 demarcation.
